option.value:
name: Build APK
on: push: branches: [main, master] pull_request: branches: [main, master] workflow_dispatch:
env: FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: true
jobs: build: runs-on: ubuntu-latest permissions: contents: write
steps: - name: Checkout code uses: actions/checkout@v5
- name: Set up JDK 11 uses: actions/setup-java@v5 with: distribution: 'temurin' java-version: '11'
- name: Grant execute permission for gradlew run: chmod +x gradlew
- name: Generate debug keystore for CI run: | mkdir -p ~/.android keytool -genkeypair -v -keystore ~/.android/debug.keystore -storepass android -alias androiddebugkey -keypass android -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000 -dname "CN=Android Debug,O=Android,C=US"
- name: Build Release APK run: ./gradlew assembleRelease
- name: Get version name id: version run: | VERSION=$(grep -m 1 "versionName" app/build.gradle.kts | sed 's/.*versionName = "\([^"]*\)".*/\1/') VERSION_CODE=$(grep -m 1 "versionCode" app/build.gradle.kts | sed 's/.*versionCode = \([0-9]*\).*/\1/') echo "name=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT echo "code=$VERSION_CODE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT # 使用版本号作为 tag，确保唯一性 echo "tag=v$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
- name: Upload APK Artifact uses: actions/upload-artifact@v5 with: name: app-release path: app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk
- name: Upload Update Info Artifact uses: actions/upload-artifact@v5 with: name: update-info path: update/
- name: Create Release if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2 with: tag_name: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }} name: Release ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }} body: | ## 天音壁纸 ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}
### 下载 - 下载下方 APK 文件安装即可
### 应用内更新 - update_info.json 文件用于应用内更新功能 files: | app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk update/update_info.json generate_release_notes: true
- name: Commit and Push Update Info if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' run: | git config --local user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com" git config --local user.name "github-actions[bot]" git add update/ || true git diff --quiet && git diff --staged --quiet || git commit -m "Update: update_info.json for ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}" git push

name: Build APK
on: push: branches: [main, master] pull_request: branches: [main, master] workflow_dispatch:
env: FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: true
jobs: build: runs-on: ubuntu-latest permissions: contents: write
steps: - name: Checkout code uses: actions/checkout@v5
- name: Set up JDK 11 uses: actions/setup-java@v5 with: distribution: 'temurin' java-version: '11'
- name: Grant execute permission for gradlew run: chmod +x gradlew
- name: Build Release APK run: ./gradlew assembleRelease
- name: Get version name id: version run: | VERSION=$(grep -m 1 "versionName" app/build.gradle.kts | sed 's/.*versionName = "\([^"]*\)".*/\1/') VERSION_CODE=$(grep -m 1 "versionCode" app/build.gradle.kts | sed 's/.*versionCode = \([0-9]*\).*/\1/') echo "name=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT echo "code=$VERSION_CODE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT echo "tag=v$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
- name: Generate update_info.json run: | mkdir -p update APK_FILE=$(ls app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk | head -n 1) APK_NAME=$(basename "$APK_FILE") APK_SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$APK_FILE") APK_MD5=$(md5sum "$APK_FILE" | cut -d ' ' -f 1) CURRENT_TIME=$(date +%s%3N) VERSION_NAME="${{ steps.version.outputs.name }}" VERSION_CODE="${{ steps.version.outputs.code }}" DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/releases/download/v${VERSION_NAME}/${APK_NAME}" COMMIT_MSG=$(git log -1 --pretty=format:"%s%n%n%b")
# 提取多行变量给后续 Release 使用 EOF=$(dd if=/dev/urandom bs=15 count=1 status=none | base64) echo "commit_msg<<$EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV echo "$COMMIT_MSG" >> $GITHUB_ENV echo "$EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
# 使用 jq 确保提交信息字符串在 JSON 中安全转义 jq -n \ --arg code "$VERSION_CODE" \ --arg name "$VERSION_NAME" \ --arg filename "$APK_NAME" \ --arg url "$DOWNLOAD_URL" \ --arg time "$CURRENT_TIME" \ --arg des "$COMMIT_MSG" \ --arg size "$APK_SIZE" \ --arg md5 "$APK_MD5" \ '{ code: $code|tonumber, name: $name, filename: $filename, url: $url, time: $time|tonumber, des: $des, size: $size|tonumber, md5: $md5 }' > update/update_info.json cat update/update_info.json
- name: Upload APK Artifact uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: app-release path: app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk
- name: Upload Update Info Artifact uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: update-info path: update/
- name: Create Release if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2 with: tag_name: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }} name: Release ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }} body: | ## 天音壁纸 ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}
${{ env.commit_msg }}
### 下载 - 下载下方 APK 文件安装即可
### 应用内更新 - update_info.json 文件用于应用内更新功能 files: | app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk generate_release_notes: true
- name: Commit and Push Update Info if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' run: | git config --local user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com" git config --local user.name "github-actions[bot]" git add update/ || true git diff --quiet && git diff --staged --quiet || git commit -m "Update: update_info.json for ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}" git push
